sentinel number 2.name: Sentinel Number 2
sentinel number 2.species: Mutant Sentinel Mk II; (Mutated by the Sun)
sentinel number 2.origin: Number Two was the commander of Larry Trask's Neo-Sentinels, following the orders left by his predecessor, Master Mold. When they were tricked by Cyclops to fly into the Sun and eliminate the source of all mutation, Number Two was mutated by close exposure to solar radiation, granting him full sentience and the power to teleport himself and others across vast distances. After returning from space, Number Two settled down in a hidden base in the Australian Outback. It then plotted to put a humane end to the mutant race by sterilizing humanity with a solar flare. WIth humanity eventually dying out, Number Two intended to work on creating a new version of the human race in the Sentinels' genetic labs; a version with no mutants among them. He thought it would be a permanent end to the "mutant menace," without actually having to kill anyone. Although it would take centuries for the Sentinels to perfect their genetic project, Number Two thought that his ilk would endure forever and they did not need to worry about deadlines. However, Number Two was destroyed by the other Sentinels when they discovered Number Two was a mutant as well. Number Two was rebuilt and revived by the Sentinels when they required his leadership. He again insisted on not killing human captives: "We do not slay humans unless they interfere with our anti-mutant directive." Dying from cancer, Cynthia Chalmers attempted to transfer her consciousness into Number Two's body. This left two personalities struggling for control of the body, with the Sentinel programming slowly merging with Cynthia's mentality. Unwilling to live as a human Sentinel, Cynthia forced their shared body into a suicide flight into the Sun.
powers: Same as those of the other Sentinels MK II. : Due to his systems being altered on a molecular level, Number Two has the mutant power to open teleportational gates.

sentinel omega class.origin: After the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants assassinated Senator Robert Kelly, anti-mutant hysteria grew and an extreme candidate was elected President. This President freed the Sentinels, giving them the open order to permanently eliminate the mutant "threat". The Sentinels reacted by taking control of the United States and all of North America, and killing or capturing virtually all of the super humans, be it mutants or not. Captured mutants were kept in concentration camps known as "mutant internment centers". The self-replicating Sentinels developed the new model, the Omega series, designed specially to hunt and kill super-human mutants. They share the most threatening feature of Mark II, a learning program. Later, the Omega Sentinels, absolute kings of the land, developed a more advanced Sentinel: Nimrod. The prototype of this project managed to go to Earth-616. thumb|left|The Sentinels at Battleworld A group of Sentinels were transported to a version of Battleworld created by Korvac of Earth-691. The Sentinels engaged a group of heroes and despite the machines' efforts to adapt against them, they were ultimately destroyed.

sentry 9168.name: Sentry 9168
sentry 9168.origin: The alien species known as the Kree developed and built the Sentries to watch over their military advanced bases and supply depots throughout all the Kree Empire and beyond. Some 80,000 years ago, in Kree year 1220, Kree scientist Bronek developed the prototype Sentry and the Supreme Council of the Kree Empire began to mass-build Sentries for military purposes. Hundreds of thousands of Sentries were built, although only a few thousands are currently active. Sentry 213 was the first Sentry sent to the Earth's system, and it was placed in a little surveillance/supply deport in the surface of Uranus. It was discovered by an exiled group of Eternals, who proceeded to destroy the Sentry and invade the depot. A second Sentry, Sentry 459, was sent to Earth to monitor the civilization of the Inhumans, one of the Kree's experiments on Earth. Sentry 9168 was left on a island at the Pacific during a routine patrol of the Kree some two millennia ago. This Sentry was eventually activated by the Supreme Council to use a stimulating gun to awake a living creature of unknown species that the Kree had placed on the Moon. The Council was afraid of Earth astronauts discovering the remains of the Kree city hidden in the Blue Area of the Moon. The Fantastic Four found the Sentry 9168, fought it and defeated it. They then used a remote control to destroy the alien creature.

sepulcher.name: Sepulcher
sepulcher.origin: In the late 37th-early 39th century, Sepulcher was a member of the Clan Chosen. Roughly in the late 36th century, Apocalypse ascended to power and ruled much of North America unchallenged, for 100 years, where humans and whoever else resistant to his rule could be killed at any moment. The Clan Askani were the only rebellion left to opposed Apocalypse's rule. Years later, following the destruction of the Askani Sisterhood, by the New Canaanites led by Ch'vayre and Stryfe, and Apocalypse, by Nathan Dayspring, Sepulcher joined the Clan Chosen, an Askani-inspired team of freedom fighters, formed originally by Nathan, Tetherblood, and Aliya. Training in the Askani ways under surviving Askani elders, the Clan Chosen repeatedly battled the New Canaanites and the Scions of Apocalypse, led by Stryfe. The Clan Chosen also clashed with the Neo-Canaanites, a group that also wished to claim Apocalypse's power. After decades of battle, the Clan Chosen signed a long-lasting peace treaty with the New Canaanites, but Nathan, upset by rumors that Apocalypse had survived, convinced the Clan's Askani Council that they needed to fight again. Sepulcher battled the Flatliners and destroyed the Tinex in Niagara Falls, after sending Cable and Kane to the past.

fields.history: In the late 37th-early 39th century, Sepulcher was a member of the Clan Chosen. Roughly in the late 36th century, Apocalypse ascended to power and ruled much of North America unchallenged, for 100 years, where humans and whoever else resistant to his rule could be killed at any moment. The Clan Askani were the only rebellion left to opposed Apocalypse's rule. Years later, following the destruction of the Askani Sisterhood, by the New Canaanites led by Ch'vayre and Stryfe, and Apocalypse, by Nathan Dayspring, Sepulcher joined the Clan Chosen, an Askani-inspired team of freedom fighters, formed originally by Nathan, Tetherblood, and Aliya. Training in the Askani ways under surviving Askani elders, the Clan Chosen repeatedly battled the New Canaanites and the Scions of Apocalypse, led by Stryfe. The Clan Chosen also clashed with the Neo-Canaanites, a group that also wished to claim Apocalypse's power. After decades of battle, the Clan Chosen signed a long-lasting peace treaty with the New Canaanites, but Nathan, upset by rumors that Apocalypse had survived, convinced the Clan's Askani Council that they needed to fight again. Sepulcher battled the Flatliners and destroyed the Tinex in Niagara Falls, after sending Cable and Kane to the past.

serah anchorton.name: Serah Anchorton
serah anchorton.origin: Lady Serah Anchorton was a member of the Holy Order and worked as a Witch Hunter, hunting down Witchbreed to protect the inhabitants of King James' England in the name of the All-Mighty God Emperor Doom. ===Secret Wars=== With the population of Witchbreed diminished, Lady Serah and her partner, Sister Angela of the Holy Order, went on to hunt Faustians, people who made deals with Demons. However, before doing so, they went to the Mermaid Tavern to drink with some friends of theirs. There, they attacked Captain James Buchanan Barnes of Clan Buchanan whom they believed was a Witchbreed, but it revealed itself to be a Faustian after being cut in half by Angela and reanimating its two halves as hideous monsters. Lady Serah killed the upper half and, as Angela killed the bottom half, it summoned its "maker": the Enchantress of the Faerie. Angela tried to hit her, but she couldn't do her harm. Then the Enchantress menaced to kill Serah before she could kill three more of her Faustians before vanishing in the air, leaving an worried Angela behind. After Angela told her about Enchantress' menace, Serah and her fellow Witch Hunter departed from London and found a troupe of players being attacked by beasts in the woods. They aided the Gardiner's Men to kill the beasts and, as the creatures had traces of Enchantress' magic on them, indicating she was somewhere nearby, traveled with them to a pagan village in the outskirts of York, where a marriage for the town beauty, Anne Weying, and the young printer's apprentice, Edwin Brocc, was going to happen. As the festival proceeded, Angela realized young Edwin had enchanted his bride to marry him when she spotted him giving her a potion to drink. Edwin noticed Angela was seeing and panicked, becoming a venomous monster and attacking her. Angela and her companions engaged him in battle and subdued him. Angela decapitated him soon afterwards. While leaving the town, Serah told Angela she wasn't afraid of her fate as long as Angela was with her. Serah and Angela then headed to Castle Caldecote, in Cumberland, as it was the whereabouts of the third Faustian. Her name was Anna Maria, the natural daughter of a bishop that was kept safe by Master Coulson in one of the castle's room, as instructed by her father. However, in the last new moon, she managed to escape the castle and returned somewhat different. Seeing the girl was not mad as Coulson said she was, Serah demanded the girl to be freed from her chains and told Angela to keep an eye on her. As the days passed, Serah, who had been studying about the Faerie, discovered that the Enchantress sent a sliver of herself into each of those with who she strike a deal and that she was using stories, such as that of her victims and Kit Marlowe's play, to expand her power. Upon figuring it out, Serah started to devise a plan to counter that of Enchantress. Later that night, Angela heard strange noises coming from Anna Maria's room and went to check if everything was right. There she found the girl crying, frightened by the Enchantress' voice inside her head. The girl asked Angela to tell her a story to calm her down, and so she did, but was in vain as the Enchantress took control of the girl's body and attacked Angela. The girl managed to regain consciousness though and in an attempt to be free again, used Angela's weapon to kill herself. Serah showed up and was able to revive the girl, who was a Faustian no more. As she hasn't died, Serah thought she was safe from the Enchantress' wrath, but she was wrong as the Faerie rose from the blood of her lost Faustian and took Serah's life, fulfilling her menace. With the sun setting, Angela burned her lover's body to the ashes, recovering her skull and singing to it afterwards. Suddenly, to Angela's surprise, the skull became animated and started to talk with her. Having cheated death using the same arms as Enchantress, Serah led Angela to the Realm of the Faerie in order to destroy the Faerie Queen. Once in the Realm of the Faerie, Angela was tempted by Enchantress, who showed to her illusions of what would be a better life for her. However, Serah helped Angela to snap out of it and then she confronted Enchantress. Angela managed to overcome and kill the Enchantress, and was cursed with her power for it, becoming the Faustian Queen. With her newfound powers, Angela resurrected Serah and, fearing such power would corrupt her, sent her back to the mortal world. Sad by having lost her lover, Serah went on a quest to recover Angela. Later, Serah approached Kit Marlowe in the Mermaid Tavern and confronted him, revealing to him she discovered he was a Faustian himself and that he was helping the Enchantress expand her power since the beginning, which was acknowledged by him. Afterwards, Serah captured him and trapped him inside an Iron Man, which drained his blood. As it contained the very magic of story, Serah gave Marlowe's blood to her friend William Shakespeare in order to him immortalize Angela

serestus.name: Serestus
serestus.origin: When the future despot Kang and his son, Marcus hatched a plot for world domination, they offered portions of the soon-to-be conquered Earth to any villainous groups or races who would help them by launching attacks against humanity. The ruler of the Atlanteans, Attuma was one of the first to take up this offer, and launched an attack on the shores of Canada. To help him in this plot, he had Serestus, an Atlantean sorceror, control Torg using a crystal ball, though Serestus found it difficult to concentrate on controlling Torg while Attuma boasted about their progress beside him. The Avengers opposed their plans, and while several of the Avengers engaged Torg in battle, Triathlon leaped from rock to rock to the Atlantean craft Attuma and Serestus were standing on in the bay, and snatched the crystal from Serestus' hands. Serestus' control over Torg was broken, and Torg turned against the Atlanteans who had been controlling him.
powers: Serestus possessed certain sorcerous powers, the limits of which are unknown.

serge plotski.name: Serge Plotski
serge plotski.origin: Serge Plotski was a communist agent operating in Africa, where he supplied firearms and explosives to local tribes in order to incite uprisings. While piloting his aircraft to deliver weapons to another group, his plane was struck by lightning during a storm, forcing him to abandon control and crash-land near the territory of an isolated and previously unknown tribe. The tribe lived behind an enormous defensive wall constructed to protect their settlement from a gigantic and dangerous creature that roamed the land beyond it. Stranded and without allies, Plotski attempted to manipulate the situation to his advantage. Using the flame of his lighter and the firing of his last remaining bullet, he convinced the tribespeople that he was a god who had descended from the sky. Rather than welcoming or serving him, the natives escorted Plotski outside the protective wall and left him there alone and unarmed. Believing him to possess divine powers, they instructed him to prove his claim by destroying the monstrous beast that threatened their people.

sergei panshin.first_appearance: Captain America/Nick Fury: Blood Truce Vol 1 1
sergei panshin.origin: Son to KGB torturer Dmitri Panshin and his wife Sonya Panshin, who died when Sergei was a child. He studied in Prague and was friendly with Boris Bullski, the Titanium Man, whom he called "Uncle Boris". After the end of the Cold War, Dmitri attempted to desert and join any government or party paying him the most, with the U.S. Government and S.H.I.E.L.D. being the winners, much to A.I.M.'s chagrin. A rogue S.H.I.E.L.D. cell wanted to get even on Dmitri and in the operation their armored agent, Agent Orange, kidnapped Sergei as they had lost Dmitri. Orange kept Sergei hostage and offered to trade him for Dmitri in East Germany while pretending to be working for Hydra. The exchange was done under the supervision of the Titanium Man and Captain America, whom Sergei respected. Dmitri was later rescued and deserted properly, with Sergei having a chance to grow in western countries as Dmitri had wanted.

sergey antonov.name: Sergey Antonov
sergey antonov.first_appearance: Daredevil/Punisher: Seventh Circle Infinite Comic Vol 1 1
sergey antonov.origin: Sergey Antonov was a Russian mobster who was arrested by Daredevil in Hell's Kitchen. However, imn order to get an impartial trial, Murdock decided to send him to Texas. On the way there, they were attacked by Punisher, who attempted to kill him. Daredevil managed to stick his billy club in Punisher's van's exhaust, which caused the car to over heat. Then, they were attacked by Antonov's men, who wanted to break him out. However, they were all defeated. Before being captured again, he managed to send out a call to hire Crimson Dynamo to break him out. Crimson Dynamo then arrived along with Punisher, and while the three of them fought, he escaped to the airport, where he murdered two guards and stole a uniform. Meanwhile, Crimson Dynamo was killed by Punisher, who in turn was knocked out by Daredevil. Meanwhile, Blindspot went to the security room and located Antonov in the airport. He confronted Antonov and with the help of Daredevil who arrived shortly afterward, defeated Antonov. Antonov was then escorted onto a plane which was flown to Texas, however Punisher remarked that it was a death penalty state and his crimes would likely result in an execution. He has not been seen since.

sergey valberg.name: Sergey Valberg
sergey valberg.origin: Sergey Valberg (Russian: Сергей Валберг) was a ballet dancer and teacher from Russia. At some point he migrated to the United States of America and joined the corps de ballet in Manhattan. During one of his practice session, he was attacked by an enigmatic Bora. Sergey heard about her before, a cold-hearted woman, who killed one of his former students from Russia, Mariya Andreyanova. However, when Sergey saw Bora, he was shocked to realize that she was also his former student. Bora accused him of "stealing" his gift from their country, but Sergey refused to accept the blame. It was his life, so only he could decide how to live it. As Bora summoned cold winds to kill him, Sergey started to dance. Bora thought he was doing so to change her mind, but instead he was doing it to die the way he lived, by honoring life through the dance. Temperature in the room dropped to 60 degrees below zero and Sergey eventually succumbed to it and died. Bora's actions were witnessed by Moon Knight, but since he was heavily injured, he was unable to help Sergey. However, the way Sergey faced his death and his courage inspired Moon Knight to overcome his injuries.

sergio torres.name: Sergio Torres
sergio torres.origin: El Toro Negro was a participant of the Great Game, a betting competition between super-powered individuals organized by their own sponsors. El Toro Negro's sponsor was Justin Hammer, the very same mastermind behind the competition, who also tasked el Toro Negro with adopting the role of the "rogue player," seeking revenge on the financers who wouldn't sponsor him. In reality, since many of the participants were businesspeople, their deaths would make their companies ripe for hostile takeovers from Hammer Industries. In exchange for taking down Hammer's rivals, Torres was promised a "great prize." On his first match, el Toro Negro allowed his opponent Joystick to defeat him, due to Hammer having bet against him because he was favored more than twenty-to-one. Under the pretense of wanting a rematch, el Toro Negro followed Joystick to the United States and assaulted Henri, one of the Great Game's agents, demanding Joystick's whereabouts. El Toro was later sent by Paris Scott of the Great Game to forcibly recruit the super-hero Poison into the Game, by taking her son hostage. Poison nearly agreed to his demands, but Spider-Man arrived, and convinced her not to trust him. Ultimately, Poison helped Spider-Man defeat El Toro Negro. Once he killed Joystick's sponsor Chu Chi-Huan, el Toro Negro interrupted a fight between Polestar and Nightwatch when the latter was trying to stop the former from capturing Nolan Morelle. After teaming up with Polestar to take down Nightwatch, el Toro killed his short-time ally and kidnapped Nolan. Before murdering Paris Scott, el Toro Negro blasted with a bazooka Scott's player, the Rocket Racer, and his rival, the Prowler, though both survived. Before he could attempt on the life of John Jonah Jameson, who was secretly sponsoring Spider-Man without the hero's knowledge, el Toro Negro was attacked by Spidey, with another participant, Chance, joining the brawl. Joystick also appeared, with the intention to take down el Toro Negro again. Spider-Man tricked el Toro Negro into disclosing his agenda while being observed by the sponsors of the Great Game, though Torres claimed James Johnsmeyer was his sponsor rather than Hammer. Right after being webbed up by Spider-Man, el Toro Negro was taken away by Chance and delivered to Hammer. El Toro Negro woke up next in Justin Hammer's laboratory, strapped to a table. Under the pretense he was granting Sergio the great prize, power beyond his wildest dreams, Hammer argued he had to first remove his least powerful asset, his mind, for which he impaled him with a saw to perform a lobotomy. El Toro Negro resurfaced many years later, having become a lackey of New Jersey mobster el Tenor. He was tasked with killing Tenor's prisoner Slapstick. Unfortunately, with Torres having become easily susceptible since his lobotomy, Slapstick easily got el Toro Negro to free him.

serpentyne.name: Serpentyne
serpentyne.origin: thumb|left Serpentyne was a Saurian who were created by the atomic testing. At some point Dire Wraiths attacked and seemingly killed every Saurian so they could use there subterranean lair for themselves. Serpentyne survived only because a cave-in seperated him and he vowed vengeance. Travelling to Clairton, West Virginia, Serpentyne continued exterminating any Dire Wraiths he found infiltrating the town. Here he learned of ROM and his Neutralizer and decided it was a weapon he desired for himself and deemed himself to be the only one who deserved to possess it. A battle with Rom ensued in his current underground lair over the Neautralizer. Their fight came to an abrupt halt when Serpentyne was accidentally impaled on a stalagmite after tripping over a skull. With his last words, he apologized to Rom, admitting he had gone mad with vengeance. He asked Rom not to grieve for him, as he was going to rejoin his dead people.

set dagon.name: Set-Dagon
set dagon.species: Elderspawn ; Member of a race of serpent-fish-men spawned by Set and Dagon
set dagon.origin: ===Origins=== Set-Dagon and his people were part of a race of serpent-fish-men spawned by their ancestors, the Elder God Set and the god Dagon. They resided in an unidentified dimension. ===Modern Age=== By the Modern Age, Set-Dagon seemingly led his people. As his friend Dr. Hammond was dying, Morbius used the Vaal Talisman to steal mystic powers from Doctor Strange, along with a rub of the Darkhold, and consequently accidentally enabled Set-Dagon and his people to invade Earth. Set-Dagon and his brethren tried to dispel other mystical barriers in order for the forces of darkness to overrun the Earth dimension. While Strange and Spider-Man were looking for Morbius from the Sanctum Sanctorum, the serpent-fish-men attacked them. They managed to escape the sanctum, only to be captured in the street. While Set-Dagon tortured them, Spider-Man finally managed to mystically locate Morbius, and the pair escaped to his location, which was also attacked by the serpent-fish-men. Spider-Man managed to destroy the Vaal Talisman, returning his powers to Strange who banished the interlopers back to their dimension.
weapons: Hammer

seth neo.name: Seth (Neo)
seth neo.origin: Seth was secretly a member of the Warclan, one of the different communities of the Neo, who comprised different clans of recluse mutants. The Neo suffered a major crisis after the High Evolutionary temporarily deactivated the mutant gene. As a result, they unleashed their rage upon Earth and, more specifically, the X-Men, a group of mutant activists who promoted racial integration. The Warclan brutally attacked the X-Men. Seth played the role of a mole, being planted as a spy at Cape Canaveral to investigate the High Evolutionary's space station. He was able to seduce the X-Man Kitty Pryde, showing his true colors by restraining her and sabotaging the station. Although she attacked him, he was able to evade capture and death by running away. At some point, the surviving Neo were claimed to have been wiped out by Evolutionaries. Although their fate is uncertain, their survival seems unlikely.
powers: Has peak human strength, speed, endurance, and reflexes. He can generate massive amounts of neurosynaptic energy that he can use to affect the nervous systems of others in various ways. Seth also wears biomorphing metal armor.

seth blye.name: Seth Blye
seth blye.origin: Professor Seth Blye was a scientist who discovered the presence of other dimensions and built a machine that could connect to them. With this machine he managed to transport a one-year-old child who he then gave up for adoption to a good family since he was not able to raise him himself. Later he helped a boy named Henry Hill with his studies given his potential and took care of covering all the expenses since Henry was an orphan. Later the Professor's diary and machine were found by Abner Ferris, a person very envious of Henry's success and reading the diary he became convinced that the child from the other dimension was Henry and when he destroyed the machine thinking that it would bring Henry back to the other dimension the one who disappeared was instead Abner, he who was in fact the child from the Professor's diary.

seth forrest.name: Seth Forrest
seth forrest.origin: Dr. Seth Forrest was a doctor and scientist who was hired by Dr. Karl Malus and Angela Golden to create Super-Soldiers. Under the cover of being a prenatal calcium experiment, Dr. Forrest, Dr. Malus, and Golden recruited a large number of young women with the intent for them to give birth to Super-Humans. The experiment didn't turn out as planned when a small number the women being experimented on gained powers and a much larger number died. The survivors went on the run as Golden had her men hunt them down. Dr. Forrest faked his own death, framing Nita Young, the only survivor to have gained pyrokinetic powers, for his murder. Dr. Forrest continued his experiments, giving himself energy powers and creating an army for the Power Broker by giving a number of convicts a dangerous, irreversible variation of Alicia Guzman's, another survivor of the experiment, muscle mass increasing powers, dubbing the army the Pharmy. During a confrontation with a group of survivors from the experiment and the Avenger Hawkeye (Clint Barton), Forrest's Pharmy learned that there was a version of Forrest's experiment that wouldn't have permanently mutated them and they turned on him. The Pharmy covered Hawkeye and the survivor's escape from the ship they were fighting on as the ship exploded, killing Dr. Forrest and most of the Pharmy.
powers: By experimenting on himself, Dr. Forrest gained the same energy powers as Trace.

seth phalkon.name: Seth Phalkon
seth phalkon.origin: Seth was part of Scottish sect of Knights Templar who, for years, remained hidden in the shadows as caretakers of the Hellbent, however his greed for power got the best of him and he betray his own, releasing Agony and Basilisk to slaughter the inner circle of Scottish Knights Templar. Through the shadows he guided Agony and Basilisk to search for any other knights and eliminate them, when his agents failed with Chloe. He next targeted Frenchie.
powers: Seth possesses enhanced endurance, stamina and claw fingers. He can drain the life-force of others upon contact, slowly aging them in the process. If he continues he can drain a person until they are nothing but skeleton.
weaknesses: Due to bio-feedback, Seth can't drain the life of anyone who he is related to, causing a massive explosion that weakens him and threatens to awaken the bloodline in the person.

seth vale.name: Seth Vale
seth vale.origin: Seth Vale was a mutant who survived the United States government's persecution and joined Kitty Pryde's resistance movement. Following the end of the war and the widespread distribution of the Cure, Seth chose to retain his mutant abilities and became one of the twenty mutants who established a new community in Utah. When the surviving mutants were granted their own sovereign territory, Seth participated in the vote to determine their leader, ultimately supporting Kitty Pryde. He later worked alongside Kitty and the other mutants as they began surveying and developing their new homeland.

seth voelker.name: Seth Voelker
seth voelker.origin: ===Early Life=== Seth Voelker, born in Kenosha, Wisconsin, had humble beginnings that eventually led him to a career in academia. After earning his credentials, he became a college economics professor. It was during this time her met and married Donna and the two had a daughter named Amy. However, despite his academic background, he struggled to secure tenure and was dismissed from his position, this lead to a divorce from his wife. Seeking new opportunities, Voelker was soon hired by Roxxon Oil Company, a powerful and secretive corporation, as a financial analyst. While working there, he discovered evidence of Roxxon's illegal activities. In an effort to protect himself and gain an advantage over his employers, Voelker agreed to go through a radical surgical procedure. The operation implanted cutting-edge technology within him, enabling Voelker to control miniaturized Nth Projector technology embedded in a specially-designed cloak. This advanced piece of equipment allows him to teleport himself and others across long distances. Now working as a Roxxon operative he took the name "Sidewinder". ===Recruiting Operatives=== Voelker helped the company recruit some potential operatives. He visited Quincy McIver in the hospital after the criminal was severely injured in an accident with underwater propellers. Having lost all four of his limbs, McIver was seen as an ideal candidate for Roxxon's latest experiment in prosthetics. For a week, he was treated at Roxxon's Brand Corporation labs, where Voelker played a direct role in overseeing the process. When Quincy regained consciousness, he discovered that, in Voelker's words, he had received "Roxxon's idea of an improvement." Rather than traditional prosthetics, McIver's legs had been replaced with a prosthetic serpent's body calling him "Bushmaster". ===Serpent Squad=== Voelker helped outfit and train a specialized team called the Serpent Squad which included Death Adder, Anaconda and Black Mamba. There first mission was to find the legendary Serpent Crown. The team used an oil derrick in the Pacific Ocean as their base of operations, where they initiated a series of underwater explosions in an attempt to bring the Crown to the surface. However, the explosions had an unintended consequence, damaging the derrick in the process. When the hero Stingray investigated the disturbance, Anaconda threw him back onto the derrick, and the Serpent Squad's mission escalated. The Serpent Squad soon revealed themselves to the Thing, demanding that he surrender at the Pacific oil derrick. When the Thing came to check on Stingray, Anaconda snuck up behind him, landing a punch that incapacitated him, while Death Adder seized Stingray. Sidewinder used the threat of Death Adder's venomous toxins to force the Thing into submission, chaining him and Stingray to a pylon. The team then descended into the water, where Anaconda located the Serpent Crown and handed it to Sidewinder. As the Thing and Stingray, now joined by the Inhuman Triton, returned to confront them, Sidewinder teleported himself and his teammates into their air-submarine and fled, inadvertently dropping a depth charge that buried the rest of the squad. They took the Crown to Washington, D.C., resisting the temptation to try it on himself. Upon arrival, he handed it over to Roxxon president Hugh Jones, who was already wearing a second Crown. Terrified of Jones' newfound powers, Voelker quickly departed. ===Serpent Society=== Geoffrey Wilder hired Voelker new team that included Diamondback, Puff Adder, Rattler, Cobra, and Anaconda, with the mission to assassinate Tony Stark in Los Angeles. The group launched their attack at a scrapyard, but Stark managed to evade their initial assault and quickly fashioned some makeshift weapons to defend himself. Voelker and Society cornered Stark in a secluded hut, surrounding it in an attempt to trap him. However, they were caught off guard when Stark detonated the hut, knocking out all but Anaconda and Voelker. As Stark emerged from the wreckage, Sidewinder threatened him while Anaconda attempted to crush him with her immense strength. The attack was thwarted when Stark activated an electrical charge from his chestplate, incapacitating them. The Squad members Anaconda, Black Mamba, and Death Adder broke into Voelker's apartment looking for him. When they found he wasn't home, they decided to wait for him. While rummaging through Voelker's belongings, Black Mamba discovered files on themselves and other snake-themed criminals, such as Princess Python, Asp, Constrictor, and Cobra. Voelker returned, teleported away, donned his costume, and came back. Anaconda demanded the $10,000 he owed them from their previous job. He retrieved the money from his safe, including 20% interest from his investments, and proposed forming a criminal organisation to earn significantly more. Voelker infiltrated Ryker's Island prison and teleported Cobra out. At a high-end Manhattan hotel, Sidewinder invited sev

seth waters.name: Seth Waters
seth waters.origin: ===Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., Hydra and Leviathan=== Seth Waters was a S.H.I.E.L.D. liaison for the local branch at the Langley Bureau, Virginia, the Administrator for Washington, D.C. Bureau, and a Level 6 agent. He communicated with Nick Fury about the apparition of a Wolverine during the Spanish Civil War. He obviously disliked his position at Washington, and made little effort to hide. Listed as a trusted member of Hydra, he was in fact loyal to yet another organization: Leviathan and disregarded Hydra. Waters never served on the field for S.H.I.E.L.D. nor donned the uniform. Because of those facts (and because he was always addressing him by his full name), G.W. Bridge didn't trusted him. He was part of the meeting to discuss the threat posed by Cable at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier Hermes, and the potential of the Techno-Organic Virus technology to aid the stalled Nemesis Program. He rejected the idea of a direct strike on Cable's HQ in Hell's Kitchen, and proposed to deploy Agent 18, a plan accepted by the meeting. Bridge was transferred to the Washington bureau, where he started to inquire on its activities and asked him about the deployment of S.H.I.E.L.D. Air Cavalry in Hell's Kitchen, but Waters rejected any involvement, stating that they were out of his Langley bureau jurisdiction, that the Washington bureau merely transferred information between S.H.I.E.L.D. and the U.S. government, that Hell's Kitchen was outside their jurisdiction, and that he should forget about it, in order to keep him from making the connection between the manhunt on Cable and the Nemesis Program. He communicated with Nick Fury about the apparition of a Wolverine during the Spanish Civil War. ===U.S. Department of the Treasury=== Thirteen months before the fall of S.H.I.E.L.D., he moved to the U.S. Department of the Treasury, allegedly as someone owed a favor to her wife (who worked as the State Department). He had over 20 billion dollars in various slush accounts, providing money to Leviathan. ===Arrested, Uncovered and Death=== After finding his name in a Hydra's database, Nick Fury send John Garrett in an interview with him, but Waters revealed he knew Garrett's identity and even about Pieta's meeting, that Fury had sent him, and warned him about his organization. Garrett consequently left. Tipped by Fury, H.A.M.M.E.R. director Norman Osborn had his agents arresting Waters at his office, while he tried to shoot himself. They also found some unknown data retrieval device that H.A.M.M.E.R. wasn't able to use. Osborn had him dragged to the Stark Tower for interrogation, and quickly understood that Fury was behind his arrest, and had him tortured by Bullseye using toothpicks. Once he revealed he was working with Leviathan, he was executed at long-range (his head exploded by a single shot) by John Garrett under Fury's order, who stole the data device and escaped, only to read it to himself at his secret base of Pieta in Rome.
weapons: A gun

Later, when the true identity of the Bat was revealed, Seth witnessed the whole thing and apologized, but Rawhide requested that Seth tell people he was the Bat so Harper could keep his reputation.

seti i.origin: During his lifetime he became worried about the growing Hebrew slave population and decreed a cull of the first born. It was during this time his daughter found by a baby and drew him out of the water and called him Moses not knowing his true Hebrew origin. When the boy had grown he witnessed Egyptian soldiers mistreating a Hebrew slave, and so killed the soldier. To evade the Pharaohs wrath, he went on an exile from the city. Following the death of Set I his eldest son Ramses II took the throne and became as cruel as his father.

seti ii.name: Seti II
seti ii.origin: Seti II ruled Egypt for a short time but his reign was challenged by his brother Araamses, Priest of the Jackal headed god; Anubis. Following his death Araamses tried to seize the Pharaoh's throne, but was captured and buried alive in Set's tomb. Seti II was buried in a tomb built in what is now modern day Sudan. ===Legacy=== Dr. Peter Alraune, a noted archaeologist and his daughter Marlene Alraune spent five years searching for Ancient Egyptian artefacts on the Sudan/Egypt border. It was near the town of Selima, they discovered the Tomb of Pharaoh Seti. It was in the tomb they met a injured mercenary Marc Spector who was inspired by the Statue of Khonshu to take up the identity of "Moon Knight" the champion of Khonshu.

seven scars skrull.name: Seven-Scars (Skrull)
seven scars skrull.origin: The "Seven-Scars" Skrull was an unnamed Skrull assassin who attempted to assassinate the Shi'ar emperor. Through means unknown, he escaped onto Earth-78411, whilst being persued by Gladiator. His ship was shot down and he crashed into the Valley of the Flame where he discovered and captured Moon-Boy. They discovered the Killer-Folk and Moon-Boy described their former leader, Seven-Scars, which the Skrull transformed into. He took over the Killer-Folk and tied up Moon-Boy, until they were confronted by Devil Dinosaur and Gladiator. Gladiator took out the Killer-Folk before Devil attacked the Skrull, the Skrull transformed into Devil and the pair fought. The Skrull initially overpowered Devil, until Moon-Boy distracted him to allow Devil to bite the Skrull's tail, forcing him to transform back into his Skrull form. Gladiator picked up the Skrull and presumably returned him to Earth-616.

They discovered the Killer-Folk and Moon-Boy described their former leader, Seven-Scars, which the Skrull transformed into. He took over the Killer-Folk and tied up Moon-Boy, until they were confronted by Devil Dinosaur and Gladiator. Gladiator took out the Killer-Folk before Devil attacked the Skrull, the Skrull transformed into Devil and the pair fought. The Skrull initially overpowered Devil, until Moon-Boy distracted him to allow Devil to bite the Skrull's tail, forcing him to transform back into his Skrull form. Gladiator picked up the Skrull and presumably returned him to Earth-616.

seward braxton.name: Seward Braxton
seward braxton.origin: Seward Braxton was the first director of the National Decriminalization Institute, which was created for the purpose of using the Behaviour Modification Device on prisoners in a centralized location. In the heavily fortified center of the complex is the "Rehabilitation Chamber," which held twenty-four cubicles with a Behavior Modification Device in each. The plan was for convicts from across the nation to be sent there to be processed through the institute and then marched into the chamber to be decriminalized. It was projected to be able to process about a hundred prisoners per day. Blue Eagle and Lamprey toured the facility and gave pointers on setting up their security for the institute. Seward Braxton was apparently killed along with the other natives of Earth when this reality was destroyed.
powers: No known paranormal powers

sewer man.name: Sewer Man
sewer man.origin: Not much is known about the so-called Sewer Man or his motivations. By the summer of 1943, he was living in the sewers beneath New York City and began kidnapping wealthy men by lassoing them from a manhole. Pulling them into the sewers, the Sewer Man murdered the men and stole their valuables. After five kidnappings in the same ten block radius, the Human Torch and Toro decided to investigate. Witnessing a man being lassoed and dragged into the sewers, Toro signaled the Torch and followed after him. His flames were doused with sewer water thrown at him by the Sewer Man, and he was knocked out. The Torch arrived just as the Sewer Man tossed the hero's young sidekick into the murky water. The Torch recovered Toro, which left him off guard long enough for the Sewer Man to toss a makeshift bomb at him. The Torch deflected the bomb, and when the Sewer Man attempted to flee with his stolen goods, the Torch burned out a wood plank he was crossing to get away. The Sewer Man fell into the sewage and was swept away. A few days later Toro read in the paper how the Sewer Man's drowned body was later recovered from the water.
weapons: The Sewer Man used a lasso, brass knuckles, and makeshift bombs of his own creation.

seyganko.name: Seyganko
seyganko.origin: Seyganko was the war chief of the Ichiribu and engaged to Emwaya, the chieftain's daughter. Like her, he believed Conan and Valeria were spirits and persuaded Dobanpu not to kill them. Witnessing Conan challenge Aondo in the four trials to test his otherworldly nature, Seyganko ultimately declared the Cimmerian as the winner and justified for executing Aondo, but, since the shaft which poisoned Emwaya was aimed at Valeria, he held Conan responsible for the ultimate fate of his woman. Seyganko approved of Conan's fighting lessons, but he didn't want to leave the island, deeming it too risky; however, he was soon forced to row his canoe to follow Dobanpu on his quest to find Emwaya. Seyganko then joined Conan, Valeria, and his fellow Ichiribu against the Kwanyi, until the disappearance of the Living Wind. He eventually struck a deal of peace with Wobeku and reunited with his beloved Emwaya.

senor muerte terrorist.name: Señor Muerte (Terrorist)
senor muerte terrorist.origin: A Latin American drug lord with corpse-like features. When U.S. Senator Robert Kelly came to his country to collect evidence of his operations as part of an anti-drug campaign, Muerte had the Senator and his staff kidnapped. He ordered their execution, which was foiled by Freedom Force, whose leader Mystique disguised herself as him, countermanding his earlier order. Along with his personal guard, the Grip, he chased them out to a helicopter waiting to escape with them, but he and his men were all defeated. He swore he would rebuild his empire and track down and kill Mystique and Freedom Force, but he’s yet to be seen again.
abilities: Señor Muerte was a cruel and calculating drug lord, who would gladly kill any persons standing in his way.

sha.name: Sha
sha.origin: Sha was the mate of Zar the lion who ruled the Belgian Congo during the 1930s and 40s. Following the death of John Rand, Zar adopted Rand's son David as his brother, rechristening him Ka-Zar. He took Ka-Zar back to his cave and Sha took an instant disliking to the human. Unknown to Zar and Ka-Zar, Sha was actually pregnant with Zar's cubs and soon gave birth to two children Zoro and Sulani. Shortly after the cubs' birth, Zoro was kidnapped by the ape known as Bardak who came seeking a mirror taken by Ka-Zar. Ka-Zar slew Bardak and returned the cub to Sha, earning the mother's trust and respect. Later Sha sided with Ka-Zar when he quelled an army of animals seeking to force Paul de Kraft and his jewel hunters out of the region. Sha's subsequent activities remain unrevealed, however it's likely that she focused most of her time on raising her cubs until they were old enough to fend for themselves.
abilities: Sha had abilities typical to a female lion and was able to communicate with Ka-Zar.

shabarr.name: Shabarr
shabarr.origin: Shabarr was a priest of Bishru and guardian to their sacred temple. After Atlantis sank beneath the ocean he remained their as their guard in the shape of a living skeleton. When Prince Kamuu traveled thought the ruins of the once great city and stumbled into a hole in the ground. When he awoke he found himself in the sanctuary of Shabarr, who attacked the young boy. Kamuu tried to resist but his sword damaged by the creature and had to swim away. Kamuu then reached the Kamuu's throne room, and found a mystical sword that was once wielded by Kamuu, Emperor of Atlantis. When Kamuu waved the sword over his head, kneeled before the boy proclaiming him "Lord". Shabarr returned to death as his body reverted back to bones and dust in the water. The prince fell unconscious and in his dreams he met the ancient King Kamuu and his wife Queen Zartra. They showed him his destiny as the future ruler of Atlantis and of his heritage with the city. Kamuu then awoke realizing he never left the throne room.

He stumbled across Captain Marvel and Rick Jones who had been transported to the planet by the Supreme Intelligence and saved them from being exposed to the toxic atmosphere. shadow lord.name: Shadow Lord
shadow lord.origin: The Shadow Lord was the last surviving member of the Earth-Lords. They remained separate from the rest of humanity till they set about to stop the Berserker, who they saw as destroying the natural balance. The Earth Lords eventually stopped the Berserker using the . However, the vast amounts of death and destruction of the city of Pompeii they decided their time was up and should re-enter society. To prevent the return of the Berserker, the Shadow-Lord was chosen at random to be the last survivor member and the container for all their combined powers. To this end, the Shadow Lord projected himself and their entire city into the Shadow Realm. In the modern era, the Berserker was awakened and so the Shadow Lord returned. The arrival of the city brought about the attention of US Navy. The Shadow Lord deemed them nothing more than a distraction and sent them away. This was deemed as a hostile attack and the Avengers were sent in. Reporter Rachel Palmer followed them and was met by the Shadow Lord who revealed his origin. The Avengers arrived, but the truth was not revealed to them before they fought each other. The battle was won by the Avengers, and as Shadow Lord lay dying, Rachel was able to reveal the truth and as he died, he gave Rachel his necklace. This would later help banish the Berserker.

shadow man.name: Shadow Man
shadow man.origin: The Shadow Man came to test mankind's defences for a planned invasion from the Shadow Realm. He first appeared at an atomic research center, where it was found out that he could not be harmed due to being both immaterial and two-dimensional and that he had the power to make himself three-dimensional for a short period of time and solidify his body. He considered himself to be an unstoppable menace. News of the Shadow Man spread, eventually coming to the attention of Casey, an electrician, who formulated a plan to stop him. The Shadow Man was preparing to return to the Shadow Realm when he learned that a device had just been created to stop him. Investigating the truth behind this, the Shadow Man went to the building where the device was supposedly kept. Upon discovering that the device was actually a decoy, the Shadow Man was about to leave again when several high intensity light bulbs were switched on in the room, as per Casey's plan. Losing his substance, the Shadow Man seemingly died.
powers: The Shadow Man was an immaterial two-dimensional being who could make himself three-dimensional for a short period of time and solidify his body. He had enough to crush a rifle. He could also and shape and hide in another person's shadow.
weaknesses: Shadow Man was highly vulnerable to .

shadowbox.name: Shadowbox
shadowbox.origin: Shadowbox was a member of Fanatix, a mutant terrorist group from the same future that Bishop hails from. She with her group attacked a fundraising gala held by Jerome J. Knox, a human dedicated to improving human-mutant relations, she was about to be killed by the Omega Squad of the X.S.E. but she managed to escape from her using her teleportation powers. Shadowbox reappeared with the Fanatix and their leader Rook when they attacked the Statue of Liberty rebuilding event where they assassinated the Mayor of New York City, a terrorist action the Fanatix carried out in order to frame members of the Omega Squad for the XSE. Convinced of the superiority of mutants over humans, she supported all of Rook's plans to discredit Omega Squad of the X.S.E. accusing them of terrorist actions so that humans against mutants would start a new war; however, when Bishop foiled the Fanatix group's terrorist actions, Rook used Shadowbox to escape, later killing her.

fields.history: Shadowbox was a member of Fanatix, a mutant terrorist group from the same future that Bishop hails from. She with her group attacked a fundraising gala held by Jerome J. Knox, a human dedicated to improving human-mutant relations, she was about to be killed by the Omega Squad of the X.S.E. but she managed to escape from her using her teleportation powers. Shadowbox reappeared with the Fanatix and their leader Rook when they attacked the Statue of Liberty rebuilding event where they assassinated the Mayor of New York City, a terrorist action the Fanatix carried out in order to frame members of the Omega Squad for the XSE. Convinced of the superiority of mutants over humans, she supported all of Rook's plans to discredit Omega Squad of the X.S.E. accusing them of terrorist actions so that humans against mutants would start a new war; however, when Bishop foiled the Fanatix group's terrorist actions, Rook used Shadowbox to escape, later killing her.

shagreen.name: Shagreen
shagreen.origin: ===Origins and early years=== Shagreen was a powerful sorcerer whose reputation had inspired awe and fear from all those around him. Operating from his floating fortress L'un Dun-T'wn, Shagreen practiced various dark enchantments and gained his power through sacrificing human victims to dark god known as Cthuma-Gurath. In order to adequately protect his power base, he created two large stone serpents to guard the front gates of his fortress from enemy intruders. However, the serpents were not enough to keep a mischievous race of creatures known as Boggies from invading Shagreen's home. Shagreen discovered the Boggies' presence and coveted their innate powers of teleportation. To keep them in line, he erected a mystic ward, which prevented the imps from ever leaving L'un Dun-T'wn. What Shagreen didn't know however, was that the Boggies also possessed the ability to disappear through reflective surfaces. Although they were trapped inside his castle, they could effectively hide from him by jumping into any of the various mirrors located throughout the building. ===Encounter with the X-Men=== Years passed, and Shagreen came no closer towards discovering the art of teleportation. One fateful day, a pirate by the name Long John McGurk delivered to him a mutant from an alternate dimension known as Nightcrawler. Shagreen paid McGurk ten-thousand gold pieces for the strange individual and soon learned that Nightcrawler shared many physical characteristics with the diminutive Boggies, including their gift of teleportation. He attached Nightcrawler to a device that negated his abilities, allowing the sorcerer to study him at length. When Shagreen left his chamber, the Boggies entered the room from the various mirrors and freed Nightcrawler. They explained to him how they came to be prisoners in the castle, and asked for his assistance in setting them free. While Nightcrawler and the Boggies wandered the caverns of L'un Dun-T'wn, Shagreen busied himself with his offerings to Cthuma-Gurath. He instructed a group of his loyal disciples to travel to the royal city of Bel Amee Anora and kidnap a princess known as Jinjav Sabree. They brought her back to L'un Dun-T'wn where Shagreen prepared to sacrifice her to his demonic god. Nightcrawler learned of the Jinjav's dilemma and mounted a rescue effort to free her. Shagreen used the power of his magic staff to animate his serpent guardians, ordering them to attack Nightcrawler. While Nightcrawler battled with the stone snakes, Shagreen found his fortune turning from bad to worse. Long John McGurk discovered that Shagreen short-changed him for the purchase of Nightcrawler and decided to mete out his own revenge. Piloting his sky-galleon the T'ai Javinee, he laid siege to L'un Dun-T'wn. As the ramparts shook from mortar fire, Nightcrawler faced Shagreen in his altar room. He reasoned that a large portion of the sorcerer's power stemmed from his magic staff, so he daringly disarmed his opponent and destroyed the staff. Unfortunately for Shagreen, the staff's magic was responsible for maintaining the structural integrity of L'un Dun-T'wn. As the eldritch energy dissipated, the walls of the fortress crumbled to the ground. Shagreen grabbed Jinjav Sabree and escaped the citadel’s destruction by way of his personal sky-galleon. Shagreen controlled a giant, flying squid, which anchored itself to his ship and guided it through the clouds across the sky. Nightcrawler gave chase and the two engaged in a sword fight on top of the squid's massive back. Nightcrawler proved successful, and Shagreen toppled from the top of his perch, seemingly to his death. He still maintained a small measure of natural magic however, and succeeded in opening a dimensional rift that transported him to another world. Shagreen appeared in a fairy tale environment populated by Pinies, Trolls and Bamfs. Within a short period of time, he established a new sanctuary for himself and began scheming upon a fresh plan of conquest. Shagreen discovered that the impish Bamfs were very similar to the Boggies from his native world. He constructed a new power staff and used its magic to capture mass hordes of the tiny creatures. He secured the female Bamfs in a dungeon and cast a spell that fused all of the male Bamfs into a towering monster known only as Dark Bamf. As luck would have it, Nightcrawler appeared on this world as well, and soon found himself crossing swords with Shagreen once again. This time though, Nightcrawler had allied himself with a troupe of adventurers, who (coincidentally enough) were fairy tale dimensional counterparts of his teammates, the X-Men. He fought valiantly to rescue not only the imprisoned Bamfs, but Jinjav Sabree as well. Shagreen captured the mutant and held him captive within the arms of a living dungeon chamber. While Nightcrawler struggled to free himself, Shagreen engaged in battle with a genie named the Wind-Rider (a dimensional doppelganger of the Earth-hero, Storm). Nightcrawler esc
abilities: In addition to his magical capabilities, Shagreen was an able-bodied swordsman.
weapons: Shagreen focuses his power through a magic staff, which greatly amplifies his own innate abilities. A large percentage of the sorcerer's magical effects are produced through this weapon.

shahrazad rafiee.name: Shahrazad Rafiee
shahrazad rafiee.origin: Dr. Shahrzad Rafiee was a physician working at a New York hospital during the events of the Serpent’s global fear wave. As mass hysteria spread across the city, she struggled to manage overwhelming numbers of terrified and injured civilians flooding the emergency wards. Despite the chaos and the psychological effects of the Fear Itself, Rafiee remained focused on treating patients and maintaining order inside the collapsing hospital system. When Spider-Man brought the critically injured Karen Anderson to the hospital, Rafiee immediately attempted emergency treatment after Karen briefly flatlined. Working under extreme pressure, she helped revive Karen and assisted in delivering her baby daughter moments before the hospital came under attack by Angrir, the transformed Thing. During Angrir’s assault, Rafiee also attempted to resuscitate Spider-Man after he suffered cardiac arrest from a hammer strike. While Norah Winters distracted the Worthy, Rafiee successfully restarted Spider-Man’s heart with a defibrillator, allowing him to rejoin the fight and drive Angrir away from the hospital.

shaitan microverse.origin: Prince Shaitan was the brother of Acroyear, hereditary ruler of the planet Spartak. He allied himself with the despotic Baron Karza and sold his brother into slavery in order to steal his throne, but was later killed by Acroyear in personal combat. Later, Shaitan was resurrected in a semi-undead state by Acroyear elders devoted to Karza. However, when Karza refused to let him kill his brother, he betrayed the Baron by keeping his Microverse forces from coming to Earth while allowing the rebel forces through, and attempted to channel the Worldmind of Spartak through himself in order to destroy Karza, the power was too much for his reanimated form, as it could only be channeled by a living mind, and it burned him out.

shane mundy.name: Shane Mundy
shane mundy.origin: Shane Mundy was a bank robber who worked with Alf Robbins. After one bank robbery, they stumbled across Orphan and killed its Dreamguard. Orphan then merged with Mundy, which caused Alf to flee and due to the power of Orphan and his own alcoholism began to be attacked by monsters. He was eventually found by Force Works who lead them back to Orphan, but were attacked just before getting there and Alf died from fright. Mundy used Orphan to trap Force Works in there own worst nightmare, but eventually escaped. Shane unleashed another monster attack on Force Works when they tried to approach Orphan. Spider-Woman and U.S. Agent found the unconscious Mundy lying on the floor. Spider-Woman's psi-web caused a dream energy feedback which enabled Orphan to realize how morally corrupt Mundy was and killed Mundy.

shang ti.name: Shang-Ti
shang ti.origin: Shang-Ti is a member of the Xian pantheon of gods, he is worshiped by some Chinese religions as the god of goodness. He supports causes that are seen as good, and destroys those carrying out evil. His origins and histories are unknown. With the outbreak of the Korean War in the 1950s, a commanding officer in the People's Liberation Army convinced his troops to be loyal to the Communist occupation of Korea by having some of his men pose in a giant mock up of Shang-Ti. This effigy was encountered by American troops Battle Brady and Socko Swenski. They exposed the effigy as a hoax, but were captured and the secret covered up to insure continued loyalty of the Chinese soldiers. However, before Battle Brady and Socko Swenski could be executed the real Shang-Ti arrived and began slaughtering the Chinese troops, either not agreeing with the invasion of South Korea or in anger at the Chinese army for using his image. Eventually the Chinese soldiers who survived surrendered and bowed down to Shang-Ti. Shang-Ti then vanished as suddenly as he appeared, leaving Battle and Socko to wonder if what they witnessed really happened. Shang-Ti has not been seen since, his present activities are unknown.
abilities: As a member of the Xian race, Shang-Ti is extremely long-lived but not immortal
He had aged at an extremely slow rate upon reaching adulthood. His body is three times denser than normal human beings.
weapons: Shang-Ti wielded a double bladed ax.

shann.name: Shann
shann.origin: Shann was the ruler of a distant planet. The people of Shann's planet were content, and Shann was worried that this will mean that they will take him for granted and not be awed by his presence. He soon comes up with a solution to become exalted by his people again: invade another planet. He preps his people to go to war against the planet Andromia, and has his people build weapons of war and space ships to attack the people. They find the people of Andromia are peaceful farmer folk, and are easily defeated. Shann has his troops destroy their cities and farm lands in the name of conquest until the people of Andromia surrender. Shortly after their conquest of the planet, Shann is praised as a hero, but soon comes to realize that his decimation of Andromia's means of being self sufficiency has forced him to provide to them, so that they do not starve. Soon the people of Shann's planet begin having to work to sustain the people of Andromia, as well. Eventually, the people of Shann's home world grow to hate him for lowering their quality of life. Soon, Shann realizes his own vanity has cost him the respect of his people.

shanna red slayer.name: Shanna (Red Slayer)
shanna red slayer.origin: Shanna was a member of King Kull's Red Slayers, a group the finest warriors of Valusia. Shanna and a group of Slayers accompanied Kull and Brule on their journey to find the fabled temple of the Serpent-Men. While attempting to reach the temple, by crossing a large river on a raft, the group was attacked by a large sea dragon summoned by Serpent-Men priests. The creature destroyed the raft, and sent the group, including Shanna, into the water. While the group was thrashed about the river by the monster, Kull and Brule drove the monster off with their weapons. After surfacing, Kull pulled Shanna's lifeless body to the shore, but was unable to revive him.
abilities: As a Red Slayer, it can be assumed that Shanna was well-versed in combat.
weapons: Broad sword.

shannon fitzpatrick.name: Shannon Fitzpatrick
shannon fitzpatrick.origin: Muse was James Johnsmeyer's greatest player in the Great Game, a series of staged fights between superhumans. At some point she faced off against Quorum, another of Johnsmeyer's players. Muse and Mosh followed Detective Jacob Raven to the warehouse where Kaine's body had been moved and stole it, bringing it back to Johnsmeyer's estate, where he was nursed back to health. Muse greeted the newly-revived Kaine as he defeated Quorum, Mosh, and several other thugs. After giving Johnsmeyer a progress report, she attended to Kaine, explaining his resurrection. She introduced him to Johnsmeyer, but Kaine refused his offer to play in the Great Game and left. While leaving the Johnsmeyer estate, Quorum and Mosh confronted him, but Muse knocked Quorum out and mesmerized Mosh to put his gun down, allowing Kaine to defeat him. She asked Kaine to take her with him. As Muse and Kaine escaped through a New York City alleyway, they were confronted by the Rhino, who had joined the Great Game. As the Rhino tried to goad Kaine into a fight, Spider-Man intervened, rescuing Muse from a toppled wall only to be buried in rubble himself. In the confusion, Muse and Kaine escaped.
powers: Muse could project and the behavior of other people. She is a telepath.

fields.notes: Shannon rekindled memories of Louise Kennedy in Kaine, the first love of his life who had eventually betrayed him. Kaine grabbed Shannon by the throat and attempted to strangulate her, despite his attraction to her. Yet, Shannon still attacked Spider-Man in order to protect Kaine. She seems to genuinely care for her short-term partner Kaine, though it is unclear if she is romantically interested in him. It is unclear how Shannon gained her powers, but she was considered a likely mutant by the writers of the Appendix to the Marvel Handbook. She has explicitly mentioned that she has restrained the use of her blasts during her encounters with Kaine and Ben Reilly, and she went against orders to not harm them. Her blasts are strong enough to blast holes in walls, but she seems hesitant to use them in a lethal way.
fields.trivia: In her few appearances, she was depicted at times with light brown hair, and at times with red hair. Her energy blasts seem to have the same purple shade as her uniform.

shannon kane.name: Shannon Kane
shannon kane.origin: Shannon Kane's husband created a "spider web fluid" similar to that used by Spider-Man. Unfortunately, he was murdered by Communists, leading Shannon Kane to become the Spider Queen and use his web fluid against criminals. She became the "sworn enemy of saboteurs, racketeers, gangsters -- criminals of every sort." With her web fluid, she could stick people to walls and the ground and swing from buildings; she designed web bracelets that functioned like Spider-Man's web-shooters. She apparently also had affairs with Krupp and Speer, giving her access to experimental technology. Though she originally envisioned herself as an enemy to evildoers everywhere, Shannon Kane joined the Battle-Axis because she believed that only the Axis powers could eliminate the threat of Communism. She aided the team in "Project Mojave", a plan to use a device called the oscillotron to create an earthquake that would destroy war industry plants and release poison gas, thereby theoretically crippling America's ability to fight the war. The team first battled with the Invaders in June 1942 while defending a Nazi U-Boat. Later, accompanied by Silver Scorpion and the Blazing Skull, the Invaders attacked them again when Battle-Axis attempted to travel to Hollywood to kidnap Dr. Johann Goldstein in order to extort his brother Golem into aiding them. Though Battle-Axis managed to force Vision to intercept the Invaders by threatening to cut him off from his home dimension, the Invaders tricked Axis member Volton into releasing Captain America, who then freed the other Invaders. The ensuing battle led to the death of Dr. Goldstein and the destruction of the Battle-Axis base. Afterwards, the members of Battle-Axis were taken into custody. After the war, she established herself as a killer for hire. She was recruited into ICON by Geoffrey Sydenham in the late 1950s and was captured by the Avengers in Washington, D.C. after she was knocked unconscious by the Blonde Phantom. Spider Queen's current status and whereabouts remain unrevealed, although her costume appeared on a dummy in the mansion of the Angel in the modern day.
abilities: Kane was a skilled , with above-average agility. Kane was able to use her web-shooters to swing through the air.

shannon sugarbaker.origin: According to herself, Shannon Sugarbaker has had three passions in her life: Her ex-boyfriend Claude, cosplaying using functional ersatz weaponry, and hunting. In order to fulfill her last hobby, she used her vast fortune to buy knockoff Doombots which she attempted to reprogram and use as prey. Her plan failed, so she resorted to the closest legally available option after humans: anthropomorphic animals. Having hired the services of Kraven the Hunter, Shannon captured several of these animals, or any subject she deemed to be so. Her victims were Rocket Raccoon, Beast, her ex-boyfriend's cat Biggs, Weapon II, and Howard the Duck. Super hero Squirrel Girl was present on the scene when Kraven captured Howard, and followed him to Sugarbaker's mansion. After defeating Squirrel Girl with her knock-off weapons, Sugarbaker placed her in an arena with the other captives, including Kraven, after a disagreement with Shannon. Sugarbaker managed to knock out most of her preys, who were taken back to the mansion so they could be hunted again later. Howard the Duck and Squirrel Girl managed to find one of the secret tunnels used to bring back the prisoners to the mansion and infiltrated the building. With the disappearance of these two contestants, Sugarbaker threatened to start killing the others. Outfitted with some of Sugarbaker's knock-off weaponry, Howard confronted her, buying Squirrel Girl enough time to free the other prisoners. With the help of the others, Squirrel Girl and Howard eventually managed to defeat Sugarbaker. Her house was burnt down in the process, but everyone got out alive.

shapur.name: Shapur
shapur.origin: Shapur was the ruthless warlord of El Shah Maddoc when Conan arrived and, in short order, stole the Kothian's job. Like the Cimmerian, he was sent by King Maddoc II with untrained troops (prisoners released from the cells) to battle the savage M'Gai tribe. Shapur recovered the magical amulet which was stolen by Kollos and brought him back to Conan, eventually pledging allegiance to the Cimmerian. When they returned to the city with Imhotep, Shapur helped the Cimmerian assaulting Maddoc's castle. Shapur then enlisted Kaleb and Simeon to help Conan secure Jahli's future as the legitimate heir to the throne of the El Shah Maddoc. When his grandson was murdered, Shapur disobeyed Conan's orders and helped him fight off Ybn's entire army of assassins. Shapur joined Conan in his military service on behalf of rebel Prince Irham. Shapur persuaded in vain General Freja to recognize Conan's authority and obey his orders. A short time later, the Cimmerian won Shapur friendship's and loyalty. Conan told him to clap General Freja in chains, but he couldn't, since his men got him first. When Red Sonja was found unconscious, badly beaten, and sexually assaulted in the Kothian wilderness, Shapur blamed himself for treating her as any other soldier. As Conan told his comrades he wanted to challenge Bahkt, who was responsible for Sonja's assault, Shapur at first warned the Cimmerian of his demonic power, but then wished him good luck. When Kaleb decked Conan for grabbing Solaise, Shapur told Kobe to stop them, but he refused, since it would interfere with a matter of honor. As the Cimmerian and the Aesir then disappeared into a portal in the air, Shapur and his band traveled to the Forest of the Eternal Verities, when, all of a sudden, he witnessed Simeon being struck by a lightning, and the Staff of the Elder Gods turning into a sword. When the Cimmerian's small army was about to move on, Shapur asked Kobe to remain with Sonja and keen an eye on her, but he refused and was replaced by Simeon. When Conan bargained with Thulsa Doom to fight against the Devourer of Souls, Shapur feared it would cost them their souls.

shara.name: Shara
shara.origin: Born in the small South African country Kwarrai, Shara was the daughter of a respected scientist. She was accidentally exposed to radioactive Vibranium in her father's laboratory, after which she suffered poisoning that weakened her body, leaving her in a wheelchair. With her days numbered unless a cure could be found, Shara was sent to Hammond Labs Facility in Springdale, Connecticut, where she underwent experimental and painful treatments led by Dr. Nicholas Benson. She noticed Robbie Baldwin, a lab assistant the same age as her, asked who he was, and was looking for a way to meet him, ignoring that Baldwin had done the same regarding her. After seeking advice from her parents (who encouraged him to meet Shara, but prepared him for the inevitable tragedy), Baldwin decided to bump into her to introduce himself, and they both found the situation awkward but fun. Baldwin immediately offered to help Shara, and the first thing she asked for was to sit on the grass again to watch the sunset. Over the next few weeks, when she was not undergoing experiments, Baldwin took her on picnics and to her first, and last, football game. Dr. Benson however was pessimistic and had decided that, if they did not find a cure for her soon, they would send her back to Kwarrai so that she could spend her last days in the company of her family. The day before she was to travel, Baldwin revealed to Shara that he had superpowers and used the secret identity Speedball, so that that secret would not remain between them when she left. Shara responded by kissing Baldwin/Speedball. But that same night, there was an unexpected earthquake in Kwarrai that killed Shara's family and wrecked the whole country. The emotional shock activated Shara's superhuman powers that allowed her to stand and launch attacks that destroyed solid rock. Shara broke the outer wall of her room and fled Hammond Labs, injuring Benson. Out of control and upset, but not wanting to harm anyone, she looked for a quarry to destroy in a cathartic display of aggression; however, Shara did not notice some children playing there, whom she was putting in danger. Baldwin, upon discovering all this, went to look for Shara, and tried to stop her: First he shouted at her, but the noise she caused prevented her from hearing him. Baldwin then attempted to use his own powers, but Shara's powers nullified Speedball's. Still, putting himself in danger, Baldwin attempted to protect the children. His actions caused Shara to see the children and understand what had happened. She then used her own powers to stop the rocks from falling on the innocents as they escaped, but she could not prevent herself from being buried. As Shara was dying, Baldwin regained her powers and quickly went to dig Shara up, but only had her die in her arms, saying that she loved Baldwin. Press and TV news about this event renamed Shara Vibrania, although she had never used this nickname.
weaknesses: Due to exposure to radioactive vibranium, Shara was poisoned, restricted to a wheelchair and in a worsening state.

shari sebbens.name: Shari Sebbens
shari sebbens.origin: Shari Sebbens was a detective with the NYPD. After Spider-Man rescued her husband and daughter, she collaborated with him on a few occasions, even when her superiors at the 5th Precinct Station House were against it. Some time later, she worked with Forensic Scientist Carlie Cooper to investigate the mysterious dead body found in one of Miles Warren's secret labs. During her investigation, she teamed up with Sha Shan Nguyen, who was searching for her missing friends from the Coffee Bean and was suspicious of her college Raymond Warren--Miles' brother--due to his recent change in behavior. Believing Raymond was a clone created by Miles, they tracked him down to the Arcadium and discovered that Sha Shan's friends had been taken there. They helped the two Spider-Men subdue the Jackal and his clones, and Sebbens arrested and unmasked Jackal, revealing himself to be Raymond. However, Sebbens deduced that "Raymond" was in fact Miles, who had murdered and impersonated his older brother. After Miles was taken away by the police, Sebbens and Nguyen helped escort the Arcadium's victims back to the Coffee Bean.

sharon wolfpack.name: Sharon (Wolfpack)
sharon wolfpack.origin: Daughter of a Vietnamese woman and an American father, Sharon was an honor high school student, she was on the track team and she even had an after-school job at the local Burger Clown. Due to all these amazing qualities, Mr. Mack began to train her. When the time came, Mr. Mack gathered all his pupils and formed the Wolfpack to battle the The Nine and their forces in South Bronx, in New York. None of the members had experience in team work, but after the death of Mr. Mack and the imprisonment of Samuel Weltschmerz (one of their teammates and Mr. Mack's oldest student), they got together and won their first victory against the The Nine.
powers: Sharon has and endurance, being able to surpass a car at 90mph.

sharon banks.name: Sharon Banks
sharon banks.origin: Sharon Banks was the defense attorney who represented Flash Thompson when he was framed by Roderick Kingsley and arrested for the crimes of the super-villain the Hobgoblin (when Kingsley was actually the Hobgoblin). Sharon arranged for Flash's friend Peter Parker to interview Flash in custody, unaware that Parker was secretly the super-hero and enemy of the Hobgoblin, Spider-Man. Sharon was meeting with her client in custody when the mercenary Jack O'Lantern, seeking to make a name for himself with New York's crimelords, broke into Flash's cell to spring him. Sharon pleaded with Flash not to go with him, knowing how it would look, and was struck by Jack O'Lantern. When Flash came to her defense, Jack O'Lantern knocked him out and escaped with him. Sharon was later present when Flash was cleared of all charges by District Attorney Blake Tower.
abilities: Sharon is a trained attorney.

sharon davis.name: Sharon Davis
sharon davis.origin: Sharon Davis was a Westview citizen. Following Wanda Maximoff's transformation of Westview into a sitcom reality, she was cast as Mrs. Hart, while her husband Todd Davis was cast as Arthur Hart. They appeared on the 1950s-themed episode, wherein Wanda and her husband Vision had to host the Harts for an impromptu dinner party, in order for Vision to receive a promotion from Mr. Hart. During the dinner, the Harts kept pressing the newly wed couple for background on their relationship, which caused Wanda to start choking Mr. Hart, while Mrs. Hart could only keep smiling and repeatedly saying "stop it." Despite this, Vision saved Mr. Hart at the command of Wanda and got the promotion. Mrs. Hart was also in the 1960s-themed episode, attending the Westview talent show in the town square. Eventually, the witch Agatha Harkness released all the citizens of Westview from Wanda's spell, which led to Wanda taking down her spell over Westview and departing before law enforcement arrived. Three years later, Sharon was now living alone, given that Todd had passed away. One day, while working on her garden, Sharon was approached by a recently freed Agatha who tricks her into joining her coven as a substitute for a necessary Green Witch by telling her she was hosting a party at her house. The coven enter the Witches' Road, just in time to escape from the Salem Seven.

sharon donavan.name: Sharon Donavan
sharon donavan.first_appearance: Target Presents: Reading to the Rescue! Vol 1 1
sharon donavan.origin: Sharon Donavan is an elementary school student living in New York City who loves to sing and dance. Using the power of reading, her and her friends, Russ Chiang and Austin Burns, have helped the Avengers, Fantastic Four, and Spider-Man defeat Loki, Impossible Man, and Kang in the past. In one notable instance, Sharon briefly bonded with the Enigma Force to become the hero Serenity, gaining empathic powers. Using these abilities, she was able to subdue a rampaging Annihilus before the Enigma Force departed.

sharon friedlander.name: Sharon Friedlander
sharon friedlander.species: Human magically transformed to resemble a Cheyenne.
sharon friedlander.origin: Sharon was working as a nurse when she was caught up in a battle between the New Mutants and the Demon Bear. She and Tom Corsi were magically transformed from being physically Caucasian to Native American. Unable to explain their new bodies, Sharon and Tom resided at the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters and joined the school staff. Sharon acted as the school nurse. After the Mansion was destroyed during "Inferno", Sharon and Tom relocated to Muir Island and assisted Moira MacTaggert. They participated in the defense of the Research Center from an assault by the Reavers. Much later, Sharon and Tom went undercover at a private school to supervise a latent mutant. When the Acolytes attacked the school in search of the youth, Sharon then sent a desperate S.O.S. to the X-Men. Her allies received the message and came to her aid, but the Acolyte Joanna Cargill had already killed Sharon.
powers: Sharon possessed increased speed and reflexes after her transformation.

sharon ginsberg.name: Sharon Ginsberg
sharon ginsberg.origin: Sharon Ginsberg began as Solomon O'Sullivan's lawyer, but she was also secretly a winged mutant. Afraid, she did not make her mutation public, and was kept under Solomon's thumb, doing his legal dirty work for him, including repeated attempts to prevent Venus Dee Milo, whom Solomon managed, from joining X-Statix. Sharon appeared to be more hard-line in her position on this issue than Solomon, berating him publicly when he signed Venus over to Spike Freeman. She later returned, however, to save Solomon from a mob of angry O-Force fans, revealing her wings in the process. Upon the appearance of Bad Guy, an evil alien impersonating Guy Smith, Solomon and Sharon sought to enlist his aid in ruining X-Statix's image. Sharon's attempt at negotiating ended with her wings being pulled off and Sharon rendered unconscious from the pain. Solomon rushed her to X-Statix, where she was placed under the care of Doctor Swaine. Awakening from her unconscious state, Sharon's mind snapped upon realizing she was now without her wings. Manifesting claws, Sharon eviscerated Solomon, then went after X-Statix on the set of their upcoming movie. In her warped mind, she believed them responsible for outing her powers and then taking them away. Before she could do any real damage, however, she was knocked out by one of the film actors, Robbie Rodriguez, who revealed himself as a mutant, and captured by X-Statix.
abilities: Law: Sharon is a skilled attorney.
weaknesses: Insanity: Since her wound and the loss of her wings, Sharon suffer from psychological instability.

sharon kelly.name: Sharon Kelly
sharon kelly.origin: Sharon Kelly was a former waitress at the Hellfire Club in New York who met Senator Robert Kelly while working there after being introduced to Kelly by her employer Sebastian Shaw and subsequently married him. The newlywed Sharon visited the Hellfire Club with her husband, who was being entertained by its Black King, Shaw, to discuss funding for the Sentinel Program. Sharon dressed up in her raunchy former uniform to surprise her husband while the two men were dining. After leaving the club, the Kellys' limousine was struck by Rogue (who was being controlled by her Carol Danvers personality at the time), who had been struck in battle against the Master Mold. Sharon pulled her unconscious husband away from the limo wreckage, and then bravely went back for Carol. However, Sharon was struck by an energy blast and killed. The already mutant-hating senator blamed the X-Men for his wife's death.
